metadata.designName: Neo-Brutalist Designer Portfolio - 'Design That Breaks The Grid'
metadata.designStyle: Neo-brutalist / editorial / Swiss-grid-meets-acid. Ultra-condensed heavy display type, monospace body, electric-blue + acid-lime + black + warm off-white, duotone photography, thin technical line-work (crosshairs, wireframe globes, grids), asterisk motif, bento-like full-bleed horizontal bands.

referenceDimensions.note: Screenshot is a downscaled full-page capture. Desktop values below are scaled to a 1440px design width (scale factor 1.6) and are approximate.

metadata.motif: Six-armed asterisk (✱) used as logo, separator, bullet, badge, stamp and watermark

overlays.none: No dark overlays on imagery; duotone/color treatment is baked into the image

display.note: Closest free equivalent to an ultra-condensed heavy grotesque (looks like Druk/Anton). Uppercase only.

body.family: 'Space Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace

radius.note: Design is hard-edged: everything is square except pills (buttons), circles (icon buttons, asterisk badges, rotating badge, globe).

shadows.note: No box-shadows visible. Depth comes from color blocking, 1px borders, overlap and layered line-work. Hover may add hard offset shadow (inferred).

globalLayout.containerPadding: 0 (sections are full-bleed bands; inner content padded 40-56px)

grid.type: Mixed: bordered bento bands. Hero is 3-column asymmetric (heading ~40% / portrait ~26% / intro+CTA ~34%). Projects band is 1 label column + 4 equal cards. Services band is 1 blue panel + 3x2 grid + 1 black panel.

globalLayout.sectionGap: 0 (sections butt directly against each other; contrast of color separates them)
globalLayout.alignment: Left-aligned text throughout. Heavy left edge alignment at x=40px (1440: ~56px). Elements intentionally overlap and bleed.
globalLayout.verticalRhythm: Bands of varying height: hero ~750px, ticker ~58px, projects ~470px, services ~470px, testimonials ~245px, CTA ~270px, footer ~205px (at 1440 scale)
globalLayout.fullWidthVsContained: All bands full-width backgrounds; content spans nearly full width with 40-56px side padding.

accessibility.buttonLabels: Icon-only buttons need aria-label (e.g., 'View all work', 'Open menu', 'Contact me')
accessibility.imageAlt: Meaningful alt on portrait and project images; decorative elements aria-hidden='true' and alt=''
accessibility.marquee: aria-hidden on repeated duplicate lists; provide static text equivalent for screen readers
accessibility.keyboard: All links/buttons/cards focusable in visual order; skip-to-content link; mobile menu traps focus and closes on Esc
accessibility.focusStates: 3px solid #0B3CF5 outline with 3px offset on cream; 3px solid #C9FF2F on dark/blue
accessibility.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: disable marquee, rotations, parallax and reveals; show final states; replace hover scale with color changes
accessibility.headingLettering: Display font is uppercase via CSS only so screen readers read normal case

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS with CSS variable tokens
stack.animation: GSAP + ScrollTrigger (+ Lenis); Framer Motion optional for hover micro-interactions

componentHierarchy: Hero (HeroHeading, AsteriskBadge, Portrait, Crosshair, Squiggle, InkSplat, BlueRibbonLine, Globe, Intro, PillButton)
implementation.cssArchitecture: Tokens in :root; utility-first (Tailwind) with extended theme (colors, fontFamily, spacing); component CSS only for SVG/line-work and complex effects (duotone, grain, halftone). Hard edges: set rounded-none by default.
implementation.responsiveStrategy: Mobile-first; display type with clamp()/vw; CSS grid with named areas for each band; swap to scroll-snap on small screens; use container queries for cards.

imageEffects.duotoneHero: Pre-process asset to lime/black duotone (preferred) or use SVG feColorMatrix + feComponentTransfer filter; add 4-6% grain overlay
imageEffects.halftoneOrbs: Pre-rendered PNG/WebP with transparent alpha or SVG feTurbulence noise mask over radial gradient
imageEffects.bluesDistortion: SVG feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap (scale 6-10) on the word BREAKS, animated on hover

implementation.fontLoading: next/font with display: swap; preload Anton and Space Mono 400/700; fallback metrics matching to prevent CLS; subset to Latin.
implementation.imageOptimization: WebP/AVIF, explicit width/height, priority on hero portrait, lazy-load others, sizes attr per breakpoint; blur placeholders.
implementation.performance: Animate only transform/opacity; will-change on marquee; pause offscreen animations (IntersectionObserver); keep SVG line-work inline < 10KB each; avoid large video unless the neon tile is a short looped, muted <500KB asset.
implementation.doNotChange: Do not round corners, do not add shadows, do not center-align text blocks, do not add sections not shown. Preserve overlaps (ink splat/asterisk over portrait, arrow tile over neon image, large globe bleeding off CTA right edge).

visualRecreationRules.uncertainValuesMarked: Estimated numeric values are scaled from a 900px screenshot and are approximate; entries tagged inferred:true or noted as inferred are not exact.
